statement: A fingertip can seal the finger hole: its printed diameter is at most 8 mm
rationale: Real ocarinas use finger holes of 2.7 to 9.8 mm (input vessel-flute-acoustics-notes, section 4: Csoka's ABS alto). The same notes found no fingertip measurements and give 7 to 8 mm for a child as a judgement. In the design panel an 8.0 mm hole was called large for a small child and an 8.2 mm one marginal. 8 mm is the top of that range, applied to the diameter in the print file (the acoustic diameter plus the 0.2 mm hole compensation). The design spec's own target is tighter: 7.5 mm acoustic. Whether a given child seals it is found with a printed whistle (C25).

mechanism.how: The finger hole's diameter as drawn for the printer, read from the model.
